description:
地图名：《寂静岭3：黎明》
地图作者：港村村长
版本：V2
故事继续衔接个人自制地图《寂静岭2：幻境》的第三关电梯逃离上去后的场景，但仍没离开里世界
接下来将由这些幸存者继续抵抗里世界的僵尸，并寻找出路，然后通过点亮两处印记来消除诅咒，最后往上高处走等待寂静岭黎明的到来
=------------------------------------------------------=
MAP;ze_silent_hill_3_dawn
MAP by 港村村长
Version: V2
The story continues to connect with the third elevator escape from the self-made map "Silent Hill 2: Mirage", but still hasn't left the inner world
Next, these survivors will continue to resist the zombies in the inner world, search for a way out, and then eliminate the curse by lighting up two imprints. Finally, they will climb higher and wait for the dawn of Silent Hill to arrive
